name: Sicily, Italy

rent.notes: Immobiliare.it asking rents Oct 2026: Sicilia region 8.53 EUR/m2/mo, Palermo province 9.12, Catania 8.91, Siracusa 8.86, Messina 8.46, Trapani 6.74, Ragusa 6.59 (Idealista mid-2026 similar: region 8.8, Palermo 9.6). Modeled on an 85-95 m2 pet-friendly 2-3BR: typical ~800 in Palermo/Catania/Siracusa, min Ragusa/Trapani/interior, max city-centre or Taormina-Ortigia coast.

sources.title: Immobiliare.it - Mercato immobiliare Sicilia
QdS - Caro affitti, in Sicilia prezzi mai cosi alti dal 2012 (Idealista)

groceries.notes: ISTAT 2025 household food and non-alcoholic beverage spend averages 552 EUR/mo nationally; Sicilian total household spend (2,305) is the lowest tier, so 2 adults modeled at ~450 plus ~55/mo of large-breed kibble for a 100 lb dog. ISTAT Oct 2026: unprocessed food +7.5% y/y, carrello della spesa +2.5%.

sources.title: ISTAT - Spese per consumi delle famiglie, anno 2025 (report PDF)
ISTAT - Prezzi al consumo, dati provvisori ottobre 2026

utilities.notes: Facile.it Osservatorio Oct 2026: Sicilian households average 1,073 EUR/yr electricity (2,034 kWh) = 89/mo and 707 EUR/yr gas (444 Smc) = 59/mo. Water (UIL 2026, 180 m3): Palermo 561, Catania 326 EUR/yr = ~37/mo avg; TARI Sicily regional average 402 EUR/yr (Catania 602) = 34/mo. ARERA gas 0.84 EUR/Smc Sept 2026 and ISTAT regulated energy +59.5% y/y widen the max. Excludes internet.

healthcare.notes: National rule: non-EU elective-residence retirees join the SSN by voluntary enrolment at 7.5% of income up to 20,658 EUR plus 4% up to 51,645, minimum 2,000 and maximum 2,789 EUR per person per calendar year. Two enrolments: min 333/mo, typical ~450/mo, max 2x2,789 plus private top-up (Feather from 72/mo per person) ~670/mo. Re-modeled to carry the full health-coverage cost; Sicilian public hospitals have longer waits so a top-up is common.

sources.title: ASL 1 Sassari - Informativa contributi iscrizione volontaria SSN
The Local - How much does it cost to register with Italy's national health service in 2025

insurance.notes: Re-modeled from old template (105 = health) to tenant contents/liability only. Money.it (June 2026): basic home policy 120-180 EUR/yr, multi-risk incl. theft 200-350/yr; tenant RC-locativa plus contents ~180/yr = 15/mo.

sources.title: Money.it - Quanto costa davvero assicurare una casa (2026)

petCare.notes: Finanza.com (updated Oct 2026): average yearly vet spend for a dog ~341 EUR, base visit from 39 EUR in Palermo, annual vaccines 40-80. Weight-dosed parasite and leishmaniasis prevention for a 100 lb dog scales this to ~600 EUR/yr = 50/mo.

sources.title: Finanza.com - Cure veterinarie: quanto costano davvero cani e gatti nelle citta italiane

petDaycare.notes: Cronoshare boarding guide (Italy, southern listings): 15-20 EUR/day standard, 20-26 EUR/day large dog, 8-10 EUR/hour daycare. Modeled as ~5-6 boarding days per month on average at ~22/day.

sources.title: Cronoshare - Pensione per cani, guida prezzi

petGrooming.notes: Cronoshare national grooming price guide: 10-40 EUR, average 25 per session; large double-coated bath/deshed/dry 40-60. One professional session every 6-8 weeks plus nail trims.

sources.title: Cronoshare - Toelettatura per cani, guida prezzi

transportation.notes: One compact car: fuel at MIMIT 1 Nov 2026 national self-service average (petrol 2.010, diesel 2.241 EUR/l) for ~800 km/mo = ~95; RC auto Sicily average 525 EUR/yr (Segugio.it Oct/Nov 2026) = 44; maintenance/tyres ~40; bollo and revisione ~15. Palermo AMAT monthly pass ~25-39 EUR as an alternative in the city; elsewhere a car is needed.

sources.title: Segugio.it - Osservatorio assicurazioni auto Sicilia
L'Adige - MIMIT carburanti prezzo medio self 1 novembre 2026
CostLiving - Cost of living in Palermo (Sept 2026)

entertainment.notes: FTTH internet 24-26 EUR/mo (Iliad 25.99, WindTre 24.99, Fastweb 23.95, Nov 2026); streaming ~30; dining out for two 3x/month at Palermo trattoria prices (~40-50 for two) ~135; cinema and activities ~35.

sources.title: SosTariffe - Iliad fibra costi e offerte (Nov 2026)
CostLiving - Cost of living in Palermo (Sept 2026)

clothing.notes: ISTAT 2025: Italian households spend 105 EUR/mo on clothing and footwear; Sicilian household spending is the lowest regional tier. Two retirees modeled at ~75/mo.

sources.title: ISTAT - Spese per consumi delle famiglie, anno 2025 (report PDF)

personalCare.notes: MIMIT price observatory (via L'Adige): national average women's haircut ~22 EUR, men's 19.5, with the South cheapest (Naples 12.8). Monthly cut for each plus toiletries ~25 = ~60/mo.

sources.title: L'Adige - Taglio dei capelli, prezzi per citta (Osservatorio prezzi MIMIT)

phoneCell.notes: Two SIM lines on Italian low-cost plans: Iliad Giga 120 7.99, Top 250 9.99; WindTre Go 150 5.99; ho. 100GB 5.99; Kena 4.99-6.99; Very 5.99 (SmartWorld). Two lines at ~10 each = 20/mo. Stored 81 was far above market.

sources.title: SmartWorld - Migliori offerte mobile

taxes.notes: Estimated monthly income tax on $72,000/yr household income. Based on jurisdiction's effective retiree rate; excludes sales/VAT/property tax.

medicine.notes: Monthly prescription medication costs for household

medicalOOP.notes: Italian out-of-pocket health spending 41.3 bn EUR in 2024 (~700 EUR per person per year); excluding drugs leaves ~45-50 per person per month for private specialist visits (~110 EUR each), ticket co-pays and dental, so ~95/mo for two. Sicilian waiting lists push more care to paid private visits.

sources.title: Quotidiano Sanita - L'analisi della spesa sanitaria privata out of pocket

healthcare.system: Italian SSN. Major hospitals in Palermo and Catania. Quality improving but historically underfunded vs northern Italy.
healthcare.waitTimes: Public: 6-16 weeks. Private options available in major cities.
healthcare.prescriptionCoverage: SSN covers essential prescriptions with tiered co-pays

pros: Among the cheapest places to live in Western Europe
Incredible food, history, and natural beauty

pros.text: 7% flat tax on foreign-source income for 9 years for new residents in qualifying southern-region municipalities <20K population (TUIR Art. 24-ter / Decreto Crescita 2019)
